audio.music_mood: playful upbeat background music with quirky rhythm

content.concept_description: A street puzzle challenge transitions to digital line-connecting puzzle attempts where every solution fails, provoking viewer challenge.
content.why_it_works: The IQ challenge premise and repeated simple-looking failures trigger the viewer's ego and urge to prove they can solve the puzzle correctly.

visuals.notable_characters: elderly woman solving street puzzle, thinker professor figure above IQ meter
visuals.notable_objects: whiteboard, marker, pencil, app search bar

emotions.emotional_arc: Intrigued by the street challenge, followed by increasing frustration as every puzzle line attempt intersects and fails.

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: A pencil attempts to connect matching colored dots inside a square without overlapping lines, failing each time.

chapterization.chapter_description: Woman attempts a circle line puzzle on a street whiteboard and fails.
Pencil attempts connecting dots on paper with decreasing IQ score upon line intersection.
Repeated line-crossing failures cause the displayed IQ score to drop dramatically.
End card displaying Amaze GO! logo, animated search bar, and app store buttons.

_audit.problem: The hook features real-life live-action street footage of a woman drawing on a physical whiteboard, not video game gameplay.
There is no Call to Action (CTA) button displayed on the end card; only the game logo, an animated search bar, and app store badges are present.
The game title appearing inside a search bar is not a call-to-action (e.g., 'Download Now', 'Play Free'). There is no CTA text present.
